response.title: Kabamanda
paragraphs: I compared the additions against the team’s current hazard-and-disruption plan: Hippowdon and Archaludon set Stealth Rock, Meowscarada sets Toxic Spikes, and the attackers can use setup or disruption to pressure the opponent. The shortlist’s clearest opportunities are to ease the team’s Fighting and Ice pressure, add action denial, or provide a distinct pivot. These are optional additions for the open slot, not reasons to change the existing Mega choices.

Primarina and Gyarados offer the most direct defensive and disruptive complements, while Rotom Wash supplies a pivot and a Ground immunity through Levitate. These candidates have different costs: Primarina is slow, Gyarados adds another physical attacker, and Rotom Wash is weak to Grass. Their sampled moves are evidence of possible roles, not requirements for the final sets.

recommendations.title: Consider Primarina for action denial and a slow special attacker.
recommendations.reason: Encore can constrain an opponent that has committed to a move, while Moonblast and Sparkling Aria provide special attacks. Its fit also resists Fire, Ice, and Fighting, helping address pressure on the current roster. Its slow profile is a tradeoff, and its Electric weakness matters when choosing it into those matchups.

recommendations.title: Consider Gyarados for offensive control and Fighting resistance.
recommendations.reason: Intimidate lowers opposing Attack on switch-in, and Taunt can interfere with status moves; both are useful complements to the team’s hazard pressure. Its fit resists Fire and Fighting, but the sampled set is another physical attacker, and its Electric weakness is a notable cost.

recommendations.title: Consider Rotom Wash for a pivot and Ground immunity.
recommendations.reason: Volt Switch gives the team a way to pivot, and Levitate makes Rotom Wash immune to Ground-type attacks, a useful distinction alongside the roster’s existing Ground resistance and Salamence Mega’s immunity. Its fit resists Fire and Ice, but it is weak to Grass, so it does not remove the team’s need to account for that matchup.
